DIA.35g6 En-8(D) BRIGHT BAR."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"4) $FLASH HARD CHROME PLATING 15 TO 20 MICRONS,HARDNESS 850."}],"comment":"The Ø35 g6 diameter carries a tight ISO fit tolerance but the drawing specifies 15–20 µm hard chrome plating without stating whether the g6 limits apply before or after plating. This matters because the added coating thickness will shift the shaft out of its intended fit class, potentially preventing assembly or causing interference. The designer should add a note clarifying that the g6 tolerance applies after plating (or specify an undersize pre-plate dimension to compensate).","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'Ø35 g6 TOLERANCE APPLIES AFTER PLATING' or provide a pre-plate machining size that accounts for the 15–20 µm chrome layer."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"4) $FLASH HARD CHROME PLATING 15 TO 20 MICRONS,HARDNESS 850."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N7","page":1,"quote":"KEY WAY DIMENSION ADDED & HEAT TREATMENT NOTE REMOVED"}],"comment":"Note N4 calls out hardness 850 but does not state the scale (e.g., HV or HRC), and revision note N7 explicitly records that a heat-treatment note was removed. Without a defined hardness specification and the stage at which it applies, manufacturing cannot verify the part meets its functional requirements. The designer should restore a complete hardness callout with units and specify whether it applies before or after plating.","recommended_correction":"Revise N4 to include the hardness scale (e.g., 'HARDNESS 850 HV') and add a note specifying the process stage, or reinstate the removed heat treatment note with full details."}]}
